narrative.northStar: The Results Page in the Meadow
narrative.overview: A familiar news-site results page whose seat bars are alive: every seat is a blade of grass, every state a pebble. Cool lichen-white ground, pine-green ink, muted slate blue and brick red, moss neutrals. Hairline rules instead of cards; dark night theme on the same roles.
keyCharacteristics: Hairline rules and whitespace carry structure; no cards, no shadows.
Party color is muted and always paired with a letter or label.
Big Shoulders numerals for counts and times; Schibsted Grotesk for everything else.
Hand-drawn naturalist details used sparingly as signatures.

rules.name: The Muted Party Rule
rules.body: Blue and red stay at the slate and brick values; soft and wash variants are for fills. Never use a saturated network blue or red.

rules.name: The Pencil Rule
rules.body: Orange means a human marked it: an upset, the current time, a watch race, or keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Numerals Only Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is for numbers, times, and the masthead title. Never set sentences in it.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with a 1px Rule line, not a card, shadow, or fill.

dos: Do keep the results-page skeleton: masthead, jump links, hairline sections.
Do pair every party color with a letter or label (D, R, I).
Do use tabular numerals in all numeric columns.
Do keep the 2px Pencil focus ring on every interactive element.
Do define dark values by overriding the same custom properties.
donts: Don't use KPI cards, gradient hero panels, or saturated party colors.
Don't use a serif or cream ground.
Don't use Pencil Orange for decoration.
